findings.message: The current nine-node aggregate model has no explicit slot coverage and several nodes are below the floor; the candidate uses whole-block two-node ownership.

runtimeReachability.proof: Stage03 evidence is confined to a non-publishing evidence directory.

verifiedDimensions: All 31 Stage02 pilot slot objects and their order are preserved exactly; 19 null pilot transfer fields are covered by the separate exact pilot transfer map.
All 254 non-pilot slots bind intent, material evidence, boundary, error model, transfer, and neighbor explanation to exact technical properties and outcomes.
Every tested property is backed by the authoritativeFor union of the slot's exact anchored first-party source references; uncovered properties equal zero.
Canonical slot fingerprints are valid and unique, and coordinated two-slot semantic hollowing is rejected after recomputing slot and artifact hashes.
The candidate relationship resolves through actual candidate-owned block and atom endpoints, and mode capacities are derived from slot eligibility rather than trusted declarations.
The two-node whole-block remap satisfies the 120-item floor without padding, remains choice-only and non-provider-faithful, and is outside publishing discovery.
independentQa.boundary: This PASS applies only to the non-runtime CERT-CORR-03-TERRAFORM candidate coverage architecture. It does not admit content, generate learner-facing questions, or promote provisional canonical curriculum totals.
